prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Split Layout Redesign: Redesign the story screen into a split layout to separate background lore from onboarding path options.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Choose your journey to bring your companion to life on your desktop screen."}}
1: [sign_in, layout] Card Layout Redesign of Sign-In Screen: Redesign the sign-in screen into a structured card layout highlighting account sign-in options.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "card", "headline": "Sign In to Save Your Pet", "body": "Log in with your existing account to preserve your desktop companion and sync preferences across devices."}}
2: [adoption, redesign] Card Layout Redesign of Upload Photos Screen: Redesign the photo upload step into a card layout with step-by-step guidance components for custom pet generation.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "card", "headline": "Create Your Custom Pet", "body": "Upload clear photos to generate your custom desktop companion accurately."}}
3: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Companion Naming Screen: Insert a dedicated companion naming screen right after pet selection to let users personalize their pet before finalizing adoption.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_pet_naming", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_pet_naming": {"headline": "Name Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Give your pet a unique name to prepare your official desktop adoption certificate.", "components": [{"type": "name_input", "label": "Pet Name", "style": "rounded", "action": "next"}]}}
4: [home, layout] Centered Layout Redesign of Waiting Screen: Switch the waiting screen to a centered layout focusing attention on pet initialization status.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Preparing Your Pet", "body": "Your companion is getting ready to land on your desktop screen."}}
5: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Controls Overview Flow on Home Intro: Add an interactive desktop controls guide component to the home intro screen illustrating how to summon, control, and hide the desktop pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet is Ready!", "body": "Learn how to interact with your pet on your desktop using shortcuts and system tray controls.", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Right-click tray icon to manage settings or hide; press shortcut key to interact.", "style": "emphasis", "action": "next"}]}}
6: [sign_in, copy] Existing Account Sign-In Reminder Copy: Update the body text on the sign-in screen to explicitly prompt users to sign in with their existing account to avoid pet resets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"body": "Sign in with your primary account to preserve your desktop pet data and prevent profile resets."}}
7: [choose_path, incentive] Path Choice Mascot Encouragement Badge: Add an animated mascot encouragement component on the choose path screen.
   config: {"choose_path": {"components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:mascot_welcome", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}]}}
8: [adoption, hint] Adoption Certificate Confirmation Hint: Add a confirmation hint to the adoption certificate screen assuring users that their companion choice is permanently saved.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"hint": "Confirming your certificate registers your pet to your account and prepares it for desktop launch."}}
9: [finish, redesign] Card Layout Redesign of Home Intro Screen: Redesign the home intro screen into a structured card layout showcasing desktop integration completion.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "card", "headline": "Desktop Companion Activated", "body": "Your pet is now active on your desktop screen. Enjoy your new companion!"}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the story screen layout while retaining pet introduction maintains all base rules.
Card layout redesign for sign-in preserves the screen function and respects onboarding constraints.
Card layout for uploading photos provides clear guidance without violating any onboarding rules.
Adding a pet naming screen inside onboarding is allowed and preserves required steps and screen jobs.
Centered layout redesign for the waiting screen accurately conveys that the pet is being prepared.
Adding an interactive desktop controls guide to the home intro overlay is permitted within onboarding.
Warning users of profile resets to coerce sign-in employs false urgency and scare tactics.
Adding a mascot encouragement component to choose path maintains the screen's core functionality.
Adding a confirmation hint on the adoption certificate does not remove the required official stamp or details.
Card layout redesign of the home intro screen preserves onboarding completion flow without modifying post-onboarding screens.
